import { mapLimit } from "./concurrency.js";
// CASE js_fourth_arg_const_one expect=pass
export async function x1(items, op) {
  const retries = 1;
  await mapLimit(items, 4, op, retries);
}
// CASE js_fourth_arg_literal_one_var_width expect=pass
export async function x2(items, op, width) {
  await mapLimit(items, width, op, 1);
}
// CASE js_positional_four_named_limit_one_design expect=fire
export async function x3(items, op) {
  await mapLimit(items, 4, op, { limit: 1 });
}
// CASE js_end expect=pass
